title: IVC town planning: more structures and detail

boxes.title: Streets, houses, wells
items: Grid divides city into **blocks**; Mohenjodaro shows the ==first street layout==
Main streets: **30 feet**; streets **sloped** for natural flow
Housing fairly uniform, but **house size varied** (social differentiation)

boxes.title: Granaries & structures: added
head: Site
Added detail
rows: Near the river; circular **working platforms**, **barracks**; largest wheat finds
**Warehouse** on raised platform by dock; seal impressions

boxes.title: Dholavira: more
items: Also: dams, embankments, a **Great Bath**, special **cemetery** structures

boxes.title: Drains & Great Bath: added
items: **Terracotta pipes** for wastewater; even small settlements had drains
Granaries read as stores of **farm surplus** (debated)
Ritual bathing may survive in later ==**temple tanks and ghats**==
Unlike Mesopotamia, Egypt: ==no **palaces** or temples== clearly identified; drainage more advanced
